aim: To containerize the full-stack web application using Docker and Docker Compose, designing a multi-stage  Dockerfile for the frontend SPA served via Nginx, a lightweight Node.js backend container, an isolated bridge  network, and persistent named volumes for MongoDB data retention.
highlights: 1. Multi-stage frontend Dockerfile: Node.js 20 build stage -> Nginx Alpine production runtime.
2. Backend Dockerfile: Node.js 20-alpine with production dependency caching and 0.0.0.0 binding.
3. docker-compose.yml: Coordinates frontend (8080), backend (5000), and mongodb (27017) over app-network.
code:
// docker-compose.yml
services:
  mongodb:
    image: mongo:7.0
    volumes: [ awdf-mongodb-data-practical11:/data/db ]
  backend:
    build: ./backend
    environment:
      MONGO_URI: mongodb://mongodb:27017/taskdb_docker
    depends_on: [ mongodb ]
  frontend:
    build: ./frontend
    ports: [ "8080:80" ]
    depends_on: [ backend ]

aim: To establish a Continuous Integration (CI) pipeline using GitHub Actions, automating static code analysis (npm run  lint), backend integration testing against an ephemeral MongoDB 7.0 service container (npm test), and production  frontend build verification on every push and pull request.
highlights: 1. .github/workflows/ci.yml: Multi-job pipeline triggered on push & pull_request to main.
2. test-backend job: Configures official mongo:7.0 service container with health checks.
3. build-frontend job: Enforces clean production bundle compilation with Vite.
code:
// .github/workflows/ci.yml
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend run lint
  test-backend:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      mongodb:
        image: mongo:7.0
        ports: [ 27017:27017 ]
    steps:
      - run: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix backend test
